description:
Job Title: Associate Consultant HR Recruiter 
 Company: People Connect Solutions Location: Ahmedabad (Motera) – Work from Office Experience: 0–3 Years Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent Working Days: 6 Days (2nd & 4th Saturday Half Day) Qualification: Any Graduate / MBA (HR Preferred) 
 About the Role: 
 People Connect Solutions (PCS) is looking for an enthusiastic and target-driven Associate Consultant – HR Recruiter to join our Recruitment / Talent Acquisition team. The role involves managing end-to-end recruitment activities across multiple industries and client requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Understand client requirements and prepare detailed job requirement briefs. Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, job portals, database mining, Boolean search and referrals. Screen resumes based on job requirements and conduct initial telephonic/video screening. Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and client HR / hiring managers. Maintain and update candidate databases, recruitment trackers and MIS reports. Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for recurring and niche positions. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience. Assist senior consultants with job descriptions, sourcing strategies and client presentations. Achieve sourcing, shortlisting and recruitment closure targets within defined TAT. Stay updated with hiring trends, compensation benchmarks and effective sourcing practices. 
 Required Skills: 
 Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi. Strong interpersonal and candidate handling skills. Basic knowledge of MS Word, Excel and Outlook. Ability to work on multiple positions simultaneously. Target-oriented and result-driven approach. Good coordination and follow-up skills. 
 Preferred Skills: 
 Hands-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn or Shine. Basic knowledge of Boolean search. Exposure to recruitment / talent acquisition. Understanding of any industry vertical such as IT, BFSI, Manufacturing, Pharma, Telecom or Engineering. Internship or project experience in HR / Recruitment / Talent Acquisition. 
 What We Offer: 
 Structured training and mentoring. Exposure to multiple industries and diverse recruitment mandates. Performance-linked incentives over and above fixed CTC. Career growth from Associate Consultant to Recruitment Consultant to Senior Consultant. Collaborative and learning-focused work environment. 
 Interested candidates can share their updated CV with us.
